description: List the event's tracks (with colors) and rooms (with capacities). Use it to find a trackId for list_sessions or a roomId for schedule_session and check_schedule_conflicts, and before manage_tracks or manage_rooms. Returns tracks[] and rooms[] with id and name, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_tracks_rooms

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
